note: Triennial election of Banbridge Rural District Council, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Scarva was the only contested division. The Returning Officer's notice of result (Banbridge Chronicle, 12 October 1946, p. 2) names the member elected or deemed re-elected for all twenty divisions: twelve unopposed nominations, Scarva polled, seven divisions with no nomination and Tullylish (nomination invalid), whose sitting members were deemed re-elected. Deemed re-elected as the sitting member: the only nomination was ruled invalid. Returned unopposed.
